I definitely don’t want to change my plan, but I’m willing to refuel. Please add 2GB to my data so I can get back to excellent internet speed. What do I need to do next?

Thanks for adding the data. My internet speed is extremely important to me, so I want to make sure it’s actually excellent now. What should I do to confirm that my speed is back to excellent? Should I run a speed test or check something on my phone?

I’ve made the following changes:
- Switched my network mode to prefer 4G/5G (now showing 5G with excellent signal).
- Turned off Data Saver mode.
- Disconnected the VPN.

What should I do next to confirm my internet speed is excellent? Should I run another speed test now?
